label: Every being reaches, by a finite chain of…, from Excluded middle as a general principle… and 2 more
meaning: Bridge (#401): the secunda via's no-regress premise (STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES: the per se link CausesAsCaused is well-founded), with excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE) and the finite-grounding theorem of TruthCore.Causality.EssentialPower (STMT-FINITE-GROUNDING-HAS-SOURCE), yields that every being reaches by a finite per se path a being with no per se cause upstream (STMT-EVERY-BEING-HAS-FINITE-PER-SE-PATH-TO-UNCAUSED). By well-founded induction every being is finitely grounded in the inductive sense, with "intrinsic" read as "has no per se cause": excluded middle splits on whether it has an upstream per se cause; if so it borrows from that cause, which is grounded by the induction hypothesis. The finite-grounding theorem then gives the finite path. Only the path structure of FinitelyGroundedPower is used, not a power semantics (DISAMB-CAUSAL-POWER-GROUNDING).
